why.title: Why Al Maqr?
why.intro: Because work is no longer a place you go to — it is a place you build. So we built it for you, with doors that open onto everything your team needs.

presence.title: A living office, not just a screen
presence.text: See who is in, who is in a meeting and who needs you right now — like walking your company halls from home.

automation.title: Work that moves on its own
automation.text: Approval flows hand every task to its next owner automatically. No lost messages, no files waiting on someone’s desk.

agents.title: A bag full of minds
agents.text: AI agents that write, analyse and follow up for you, so you can focus on what truly deserves your thinking.

clients.title: Your clients, one door away
clients.text: A private portal where clients hand in briefs and follow their campaigns step by step — no scattered emails, no endless calls.

bilingual.title: Arabic at its roots
bilingual.text: Designed Arabic-first and fluent in English, so everyone on your team feels at home.

security.title: A vault, not just a wall
security.text: Full encryption and precise permissions: every door in your HQ opens only for the people you choose.

why.closing: And this is only the ground floor… the rest is waiting inside.

advice.overdue: Check whether the dates are realistic and whether something is waiting on another department.
advice.approvals: These requests hold up other people's work; delegate them or set a date.
advice.stuck: Open the operation in the Operations room and see who should act.
advice.overload: Spread the work or postpone part of it before dates slip.
advice.hours: Make sure people log their time and leave is recorded before reading this number.
advice.unowned: A task without an owner rarely gets done; assign someone.

help.title: How are the numbers computed?
help.fairness: No single score ranks departments or people. Each number stands on its own with its sample size; the aim is to find where work is stuck, not to judge anyone.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: Tasks due in the month (up to today) that are done ÷ all tasks due in the month.

timeliness.title: On time
timeliness.text: Tasks finished in the month on or before their date ÷ tasks finished in the month that had a date.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.text: Open tasks past their date, and how many days the oldest is late.

cycle.title: Cycle time
cycle.text: Median days from creating a task to finishing it, for tasks finished in the month.

load.title: Open per person
load.text: Open tasks in the department ÷ its members. Far above the average means heavy workload.

hours.title: Hours
hours.text: Hours logged in Working hours ÷ expected (working days so far × hours per day, minus approved leave).

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.text: Approval requests waiting on someone in the department, and operations stuck at one step for {days} days or more.

status.title: Status
status.text: “On target” when delivery and timeliness (those with enough data) are {target} or more.

sample.title: Not enough data
sample.text: A ratio built on fewer than {min} tasks is not shown, because it can mislead.

department.title: A task's department
department.text: A task counts in its assignee's department today. When someone moves, their tasks move with them.
